comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Dissolve (4-knob). OBNE Parting-style glitch delay: chance-gated input, smeared/diffused feedback, reversed/octave-down chunk reads.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> SONAME prefix ZDL_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 0x01CD. Reverted from 481 to the last known-working id + safe default. (The 481 bump collided with stock effect fxids and broke on hardware; the audible-on-load Mix hack is obsolete now the editor materialises patches via a full-patch send.)

params.name: Chance
params.comment: params[5]. Probability an input chunk is dropped before the delay line.

params.name: Smear
params.comment: params[6]. Feedback + diffusion: slapback .. washy near-reverb dissolve.

params.name: Glitch
params.comment: params[7]. Probability a read chunk plays reversed or an octave down.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Mix default 1 (quiet-safe). The editor materialises patches on load (full-patch send), so audible-on-load no longer needs a hot default.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
